description: Buy the SAME amount of ENERGY or BANDWIDTH for several receiver addresses in one call, paid from the TronSave internal balance; returns one order id per receiver. Side effect: SPENDS `paymentAmount` SUN of the internal balance; not idempotent (a repeat buys again). Estimate one receiver with `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` first and show the user receivers, amount and total cost before calling. Requires a wallet signature identity.

paymentAmount.description: Total payment in SUN for the whole batch. Must equal the total payout (about unitPrice x resourceAmount x receivers x durationSec / 86400) within 2%; a mismatch is rejected with the expected total.

resourceAmount.description: Resource units bought for EACH receiver.

unitPrice.description: Unit price in SUN per resource unit, per receiver.

name: tronsave_bulk_create_internal_orders
title: Bulk Buy For Many Receivers
